title: Chapter 77
text:
When the sniper hit the head, it was like a watermelon being smashed by a sledgehammer.

Han Xiao used the Spider Detector to adjust his position and shoot steadily. One by one, he eliminated the sentries, and the kill notifications appeared on his interface.

Sneak Attack Critical Hit + 200%. Fatal Hit. This attack is considered a Fatal Hit. You have dealt 190 damage to the enemy!

You have killed the Germinal Organization Sentinel. You have gained 500 EXP.

Sneak Attack Critical Hit + 200%. Fatal Hit. This attack is considered a Fatal Hit. You have dealt 201 damage to the enemy!

You have killed the Germinal Organization Sentinel. You have gained 500 EXP.

These sentries were around LV 10, and they were all normal soldiers. Their strength was about the same as the guards when Han Xiao escaped from the laboratory. At that time, he could already trample the guards, and now it was even easier.

One by one, the sentries were killed, and Han Xiao gained thousands of EXP.

[Dark Forest Assassin] completed. You have gained 18000 EXP.

The mission was completed quite smoothly. After killing so many sentries, there should be people coming soon. Oh, they're coming!

The Spider Detector showed that three fully-armed rapid response teams were driving over from afar. After getting off the car, they started searching in all directions.

The sentries were equipped with earphones and were connected to the communication network. If one was assassinated silently, it would take some time for them to be discovered. However, if the sentries went silent, it would immediately attract the attention of the Dark Crow Valley base, and they would immediately send out teams to search.

Han Xiao had expected such a situation. When the search team found the hidden sentries who had their heads blown up one by one, they would probably search the surroundings like wild dogs in heat, ah no, crazy dogs. Through the Spider Detector that he had hidden in the tree, he saw that the teams were equipped with Jason submachine guns, high explosive grenades, and RPG rocket launchers. He immediately gave up on the idea of gaining another wave of EXP. Then again, he did not intend to fight head-on.

It was better to run.

Han Xiao folded the heavy sniper and put on the camouflage suit that was covered with weeds and leaves. He moved stealthily and returned to the place where he dug the hole. He put the extra equipment into the toolbox and threw the heavy sniper into the hole. However, he did not fill the hole yet.

When he was done, three search teams found the hidden sentry who had been shot in the head. The armed guards immediately carried their submachine guns equipped with flashlights and carefully spread out to search.

Next to the pit was a big tree. Han Xiao hid behind the tree and confirmed the enemy's position through the Spider Detector. He took out a thin piece of strong steel wire and wrapped it around his glove. He leaned against the tree and held his breath as he waited.

Thud, thud, thud … The sound of footsteps grew closer and closer. There was only one person who was gradually approaching the tree that he was hiding in! The location that Han Xiao had chosen was carefully chosen. It happened to be at the edge of the alert range. The further away it was, the more scattered the enemies would be. There was a high chance that only one enemy would come to search.

The flashlight shone from the side of the tree. Han Xiao slowly crouched down and tightened the thin steel wire on his hands. He gathered strength in his legs and was like a praying mantis, ready to jump out at any time.

The moment the armed guard's feet crossed the tree, Han Xiao moved. He went around the other side of the tree like a ghost and quickly came behind the armed guard. The armed guard had already heard his footsteps. In shock, he wanted to turn around and open fire. He opened his mouth and was about to call for help. However, Han Xiao was one step faster. He put the steel wire around the armed guard's neck from behind and tightened in an instant, causing the armed guard to choke back his cry for help.

Then, Han Xiao used his knee to push away the submachine gun in the armed guard's hand. He then took two steps back and dragged the armed guard to the ground with his hands. The enemy's upper body leaned against Han Xiao's knees.

The suffocating pressure caused the armed guard's face to quickly turn purple. He wanted to pull the thin steel wire away, but the steel wire was already embedded in his flesh. His back was facing Han Xiao. His hands moved wildly, but he couldn't grab hold of Han Xiao at all. His eyes gradually turned white.

Han Xiao maintained the strength in his hands until the kill notification appeared on the interface. Only then did he let go of his hands.

From the beginning to the end, he didn't let the armed guard make a sound.

Han Xiao quickly took off the armed guard's clothes and put them on himself. The armed guard was a Caucasian and was about the same height as him. He quickly used a knife to trim his hair, then raised his collar and tightened his sleeves to cover all the skin that could be exposed. This was to prevent others from discovering that his skin color was not right. Then, he pressed his finger between his eyebrows and activated the switch of the face simulator. A triangular scanning ray shot out from between his eyebrows and quickly scanned the armed guard's face.

Scanning simulation!

Han Xiao's face suddenly changed, and in an instant, he looked exactly like the armed guard!

This was his trump card to infiltrate the Germinal Organization!

After throwing the armed guard's naked body and the replaced equipment into the hole, he quickly filled it up with soil and made a secret mark. Then, Han Xiao put on the Germinal Organization's uniform and swaggered out. Through his earpiece, he could hear the enemy's communication through the communication network.

"H103 reporting, no abnormalities in the northwest."

"H141 reporting, no abnormalities in the southeast."

The number of the unlucky guy that he had replaced was H222. Han Xiao lowered his voice and repeated the same thing as the other guy.

"H223, what's wrong with your voice?" The person who seemed to be his superior spoke.

"My throat hurts."

After pretending to search for a while, Han Xiao was summoned back. More than twenty armed guards gathered around the car, so he didn't arouse any suspicion.

The person who seemed to be the captain asked, "Didn't you find anything?"

"No," everyone said in unison.

The captain frowned. "Get in the car. Return to the base."

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes. This was similar to his plan. He could sneak into this team and follow them directly to the Dark Crow Valley base.

…

The car drove into an inconspicuous cave. After driving for about three minutes, the scenery in front of them opened up.

There was another world in the cave. It was a small parking lot.

The car stopped, and everyone alighted. Han Xiao followed the team forward and came to a stone wall that looked very normal. The captain stretched out his hand and pried open a stone. This stone was actually a disguise. It was a metal box with a card reader hidden in it.

The captain took out his ID card and swiped it. The stone wall suddenly opened up. Han Xiao realized that the stone wall was actually a metal door. It was sprayed with a layer of realistic stone-colored coating. It was so realistic that it could be mistaken for the real thing. If one didn't look closely, they wouldn't have noticed it.

"This is strange. This is similar to the information that Hesla received."

Han Xiao was confused. These scenes were all written in Ye Fan's information, and they were all correct. Moreover, they were the same as the screenshots and posts that he remembered from the players. Why didn't the interface say that [Reconnaissance II] was completed?

What went wrong? Could it be that the Dark Crow Valley base at this time was more mysterious?

Han Xiao followed the team forward. Along the way, they passed through two security checkpoints. He used his ID card to enter the Dark Crow Valley base.

This was a secret underground base. The structure was mainly made of steel. Everywhere was a cold gray color, which added to the solemn atmosphere. The corridors were winding, and there were many rooms. Members of the Germinal Organization walked in and out as if they were busy transporting supplies.

Han Xiao looked up and saw a surveillance camera at the corner of the ceiling. He couldn't help but shrink his neck.

I can be considered to be a lone army going deep into enemy territory with a single blade. Second Master, please protect me.

I've successfully infiltrated. What should I do next? Should I wander around or find someone to ask? No, no. I might expose myself if I ask. I don't know what kind of information is the target. Can I only rely on my luck? No, since the requirement of [Reconnaissance II] is to find out specific information about the Dark Crow Valley base, there must be something strange here! If the information given by the low-ranking officers is bait, then the members here probably don't know anything about it. Therefore, I have to be careful of those who act differently from the others.

As this thought flashed through his mind, Han Xiao started to walk and observe his surroundings.

…

"Thirteen sentries were killed?"

Ji Ji frowned. In his opinion, the enemy should have believed the fake information given by the external network. Why did they attack the sentries again? Was it to test the authenticity of the information?

It seemed that the intruders were more cautious than he thought.

Ji Ji shook his head. "But they are still too inexperienced."

The two-level network was a trap set by Ji Ji when he was the deputy manager of the base. It was to prevent intruders from coming into contact with them. Now, it was finally showing its effect.

Pure fake information would be exposed at first glance. In order to increase the authenticity of the information, Ji Ji did not hesitate to use the lives of his own people as bait. The bait contained some real information, which included the exact location of the base and the distribution of all the sentries and fortifications from the third to the sixth level. Only by mixing the real information with the fake would the enemy fall into the trap. The firepower of the last two levels of defense was more than ten times stronger. Furthermore, there was another trump card.

"The leader has agreed to arrange the evacuation route. The reinforcements will arrive in five days. We can evacuate by then. Before that, let's give Hesla a big gift."

The main force of the Germinal Organization was located in the mainland of Andrea. The hundreds of branches and bases in other continents were all tentacles of the organization. They were secretly developing and expanding, accumulating resources for the organization, and becoming the hidden nail in the enemy's territory. It was not the time to be exposed yet. Once they were discovered, they would have to evacuate to prevent losses. A single base could not withstand the endless military power of the Six Nations.
